TerraLens AI – Project Summary

TerraLens AI is an AI-powered Earth observation and environmental monitoring platform that uses NASA satellite data to understand and analyze changes happening on Earth.

The platform helps users monitor environmental conditions such as land cover changes, vegetation health, temperature variations, drought conditions, and natural disaster risks. By combining NASA Earth observation datasets with AI-based analysis and interactive visualizations, TerraLens AI transforms complex satellite data into simple, meaningful insights.

The system features an interactive dashboard, location-based environmental analysis, satellite data visualization, AI-powered insights, environmental change detection, and future risk prediction.

Main Goal: To make NASA Earth science data accessible and useful for understanding environmental changes and supporting better decision-making for a sustainable future.

Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AI/ML concepts, NASA Earth observation data, and interactive dashboards.

Project Name: TerraLens AI
Tagline: See Earth. Understand Change. Predict Tomorrow.
